deciding.next_step: Rent 720 matches in both sections and 4 occupants stays within band_household_max 4, with no outstanding request or draft_rate, so the rate stands and the award continues.

deciding.affected_scope: linked_claims_same_address is 20, so with this claim it is 21 versus 20, splitting the more-than-twenty and six-to-twenty levels.
